rows.grounds: mauna + ī; describes one observing silence
gulma + ādi + sañchanna; covered or concealed by bushes and similar things
nāsāgra + āhita + locana; eyes placed at the tip of the nose

items.question: What marks identify the meditating ascetic in this instruction?
premises: His eyes rest at nose tip.
items.inference: The instruction presents a silent, concealed ascetic with gaze fixed at the nose tip.
uncertainties: Exact scope of gulmādi and ritual context are not specified.
items.plain_english: The silent one, hidden among bushes and the like, with eyes fixed on the tip of the nose.
